answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with bounded random walks, limiting how far influence diffuses. A Sybil cluster with few genuine links to the honest graph has a sparse external cut and thus low conductance; its walk escape probability and min-cut transitivity bounds cap aggregate voting weight instead of allowing internal endorsements to multiply it. A haven of mutual claims is no bridge to broad trust, and even a sonnet of coordinated attestations cannot overcome the cut.
